title: Ferrum Modpack
description: A server-side only modpack for optimizations! (If you haven't noticed, made by Lartum).
body:
# **Ferrum Modpack**

The Ferrum Modpack (FeM) is a server-side only modpack. Its objective is to optimize server performance as much as possible.

The mods in the modpack and the reasons they're in are:

- Alternate current
    (Redstone optimizations)
- Concurrent Chunk Management Engine
    (Improves performance in chunk generation)
- FerriteCore
    (Memory usage optimizations)
- Lithium
    (General-purpose optimizations)
- ModernFix
    (AIO performance improvement)
- Noisium
    (Optimises world generation performance)

## FAQ

This is where you'll find the frequently asked questions. Because of how new this modpack is, there aren't any. Come back in a while!
